Post Idea: Who I am + who I help
Hook: I've been a [lawyer / broker / accountant] for [X] years. Here's why I started [firm].
Script beats: 1. Your name, your firm, and the one type of client you help most. 2. The moment you decided to start (or join) the firm. One real story. 3. What you do differently because of it.
Caption: I started [firm] because [reason]. If you're [going through X], this is who we help. Follow for straight answers about [practice area].
Law example: "I left a big firm to start my own. Here's why."
Finance example: "Banks said no to half my clients. That's why I became a broker."
Real example: Mike Rafi, injury lawyer (US), 1.1M views: youtube.com/shorts/mxPt96aIMkk

Post Idea: The 3 questions every client asks me
Hook: Every [client type] asks me these 3 questions.
Script beats: 1. Question 1, then a one-line straight answer. 2. Question 2, then the answer. 3. Question 3, then the answer. Say which one surprises people most.
Caption: The 3 questions I get asked every single week. Which one have you been wondering about? Follow for more straight answers.
Law example: Will I lose the house? Do I have to go to court? How long will it take?
Finance example: How much can I borrow? Does self-employed hurt me? What's the real rate?
